mapper.insert: insert into bank_transaction( user_id, account_id, type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, target_account_no, remark )values ( #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, #{targetAccountNo}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, account_id as accountId, type, amount, before_balance as beforeBalance, after_balance as afterBalance, target_account_no as targetAccountNo, remark, create_time as createTime FROM bank_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

select id, user_id AS userId, account_id AS accountId, type, amount, before_balance AS beforeBalance, after_balance AS afterBalance, target_account_no AS targetAccountNo, remark, create_time AS createTime from bank_transaction order by createTime desc
